(2) POST /api/manual/reseed is idempotent — all 14 add-* ids still present, no duplicate add-* ids inside any module. (3) Each add-* section has at least one steps/text/callout block. Rider app /rider loads cleanly for rider1 (0 console errors), /rider/profil shows pref-sound checkbox (data-testid='pref-sound'), toggling it updates localStorage.dina_sound. All existing shell navigation (Courses/Carte/Historique/Performance/Profil) remains intact.

critical_code_review_comments: notifySound.js createOscillator counting via a stubbed AudioContext confirmed 0 oscillator starts triggered by force=true clicks (browser requires a real user gesture to resume() the context, so playChime early-returns on 'suspended' state — expected behavior per the file's comment). The sound trigger wiring itself (toggleSound+playChime, fetchNotifs delta, RiderShell polling) is correct code-wise and could be covered by a jsdom unit test if desired.

ConsoleLayout.jsx orders-messages/unread polling uses prevUnread.current to detect increments but relies on fetchNotifs for new-notification detection; both poll independently every ~30s and 20s — fine, just note that the audio chime for a store→rider message is handled by RiderShell on the rider side, while the console side plays on customer/rider replies. Make sure polling intervals stay consistent if changed later.
orders_unread rider branch (routers/messagerie.py:400-407) counts only from_kind=='store' msgs — matches spec. The non-rider branch sums both customer and rider replies — correct for staff. OK.
